sub_tasks.requirements: For each partial vector x^(j), the kernel accumulates the partial denominator Σ_i e^(x_i^(j) − φ) into a per-row register/shared-memory accumulator (denominator half of Equation 4).

verification.spec: Unit test: expose an intermediate denominator hook (or run with V=ones) and check that after processing partition j the denominator accumulator equals sum_i exp(x_i^(j) - phi) within fp16 tolerance, matching the denominator half of Equation 4.

sub_tasks.requirements: The kernel performs NO cross-partial synchronization of a running max (unlike the synchronized partial-softmax path in Figure 4(b)) — partial vectors are consumed independently against the shared φ.

verification.spec: Grep/inspect the async kernel source for any cross-partition max reduction (e.g., __syncthreads followed by warp/block max reduction on x). verification.spec: Inspect kernel source (or PTX) to confirm the numerator and denominator accumulators are updated in separate warps/thread groups with no barrier between their per-partition updates, matching the two-thread pattern of Figure 6(a).
